loc.eh03-plateau-of-leng.name: Plateau of Leng
loc.eh03-plateau-of-leng.rules: Local Action: Test {lore} or spend 1 Clue. If you pass (or spent the Clue), move to any location containing a Gate of your choice.
loc.eh03-city-of-the-elder-things.name: City of the Elder Things
loc.eh03-city-of-the-elder-things.rules: Local Action: Test {observation}. If you pass, either gain 1 Clue or spend 1 Clue to gain 1 Artifact.
loc.eh03-snowy-mountains.name: Snowy Mountains
loc.eh03-snowy-mountains.rules:
Local Action: Test {will} or spend 1 Focus. If you pass (or spent the Focus), improve 1 skill of your choice.
After resolving a location or research encounter here, an investigator may move to the Plateau of Leng.
loc.eh03-frozen-waste.name: Frozen Waste
loc.eh03-frozen-waste.rules: After resolving a location or research encounter here, an investigator may move to the City of the Elder Things or Lake Camp.
loc.eh03-lake-camp.name: Lake Camp
loc.eh03-lake-camp.rules:
Local Action: Test {influence}. If you pass, gain the Sled Dogs unique asset.
Investigators on this space may Acquire Assets.
loc.eh03-miskatonic-outpost.name: Miskatonic Outpost
loc.eh03-miskatonic-outpost.rules: Local Action: Gain 1 Ship Ticket or test {influence}. If you pass, gain the Polar Veteran unique asset.
board.rules_dreamlands:
• During setup, set aside monsters: 1 Ghoul, 1 Moon-beast, 1 Nightgaunt and 1 Zoog.
• When an investigator rests on a space other than the Dreamlands side board, they may spend 1 Clue or test {will} −1. If they pass, or spend the Clue, they move to the Enchanted Wood.
• Each location with a Dream Portal is connected by a local path to the location shown on that portal.
• If a Gate would open at a location with a Dream Portal, instead open it at the location shown on the Dream Portal.
board.rules_egypt:
• During setup, set aside monster tokens: 1 Mummy, 1 Spawn of Sebek and 1 Dweller of the Sands.
• Once per round during the Action Phase, an investigator may move along any number of connected local paths without spending an action.
board.rules_antarctica:
• During setup, set aside monster tokens: 1 Giant Penguin, 1 Proto-shoggoth, 1 Elder Thing and 1 Shoggoth.
• During the Action Phase, an investigator may move from Antarctica to the Miskatonic Outpost or vice versa.
• When acquiring assets, an investigator may spend 2 successes to move to the Miskatonic Outpost.
board.card_bank_loan_text: When you Acquire Assets, you may gain a Debt Condition to immediately add 2 successes to the result of your test.
